scripts.build: npm run build -w @contentflow/shared && npm run build -w @contentflow/mail && npm run build -w @contentflow/api && npm run build -w @contentflow/worker && npm run build -w @contentflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @contentflow/mail && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build -w @contentflow/mail && npm run build -w @contentflow/api && node scripts/smoke-api.mjs
scripts.test:auth: npm run build -w @contentflow/mail && npm run build -w @contentflow/api && node scripts/test-auth.mjs
scripts.test:catalog: npm run build -w @contentflow/mail && npm run build -w @contentflow/api && node scripts/test-catalog.mjs
scripts.test:finance: npm run build -w @contentflow/mail && npm run build -w @contentflow/api && node scripts/test-finance.mjs
scripts.test:generator: npm run build -w @contentflow/mail && npm run build -w @contentflow/api && node scripts/test-generator.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build -w @contentflow/mail && npm run build -w @contentflow/api && node scripts/test-browser.mjs
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @contentflow/mail && npm run dev -w @contentflow/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w @contentflow/mail && npm run dev -w @contentflow/worker
scripts.verify: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @contentflow/mail && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
